title: enforce-encryption-context-validation-and-audit-envelope-v2
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds runtime enforcement for KMS encryption-context assertions and a backwards-compatible audit envelope v2. No customer action required; opt-in rollout described in notes.
description: Motivation: customers require stronger guarantees that encrypted payloads include tenant and region assertions in the KMS encryption context and that audit logs carry verifiable provenance. This PR adds an encryption-context-validation middleware in the serving runtime and introduces audit-envelope-v2 (schema + signer) with optional replay-protection markers. Changes include: 1) runtime/security/encryption_context_validator.go: middleware that verifies required keys (tenant_id, km_region, request_id) are present and match token claims; 2) audit/envelope/v2.proto + envelope signer: new schema and signer that embeds a provenance digest and optional region pin; 3) rbac/policy/translator: map existing RBAC v2 role attributes to encryption-context permissions so service roles can be granted 'kms:assert' scoped by geozone; 4) integrations/kms/mock_kms_test.go + e2e tests in test/e2e/audit_kms_endtoend_test.go covering happy path, missing keys, and replay detection; 5) docs/security/data-residency-and-kms.md with rollout guidance and migration steps; 6) helm/values.yaml flag enableAuditV2 and runtime config enableEncryptionContextValidation; 7) minor SDK surface: python client adds headers for explicit encryption-context. Migration plan: feature gated behind runtime flag and helm toggle; default rollout to a pilot org group for 2 weeks then gradual ramp; audit v2 is backwards compatible (consumers can still parse v1); when enableAuditV2=true the platform emits v2 envelopes alongside v1 for 30 days. Tests: unit, integration and a short perf canary were run; initial CI failed linting on the validator but was fixed in a follow-up commit. Security review: included threat model and KMS key usage notes. Related: ENG-2043, SEC-78, SUP-912. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] e2e test harness updated - [x] docs updated - [x] canary plan and rollback steps
